description: This file contains test utility functions for creating and managing test data such as users, blocks, cards, and boards, as well as extracting IDs from various model types within the store tests for the focalboard project.

methods.name: createTestUsers
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test users in the store.

methods.name: createTestBlocks
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test blocks associated with a user.

methods.name: createTestBlocksForCard
methods.description: Creates blocks for a specific card, associating them with the card's board and creator.

methods.name: createTestCards
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test card blocks within a board.

methods.name: createTestBoards
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test boards within a team.

methods.name: deleteTestBoard
methods.description: Deletes a test board from the store.

methods.name: extractIDs
methods.description: Extracts and sorts IDs from various model slices for comparison in tests.
